failure: Failure: Net-zero reactions are invisible, identical (alpha,beta) channels are only recovered through summed rates, and incomplete/latent species observation invalidates the contract. Theorem concerns non-null bounded-order channels; no simultaneous estimation of arbitrary hidden rates is claimed.
interface: Interface: Uses the same exact-reset, independent-run, complete labeled endpoint, calibrated-time stochastic mass-action contract as N559. It concerns infinitesimal jump intensities reconstructed through short-time endpoint laws; no reaction-event trajectory is assumed. Finite-sample rate recovery is epsilon-accurate under an explicit positive rate floor and known bounds.

claims.title: Newton differences recover each observable non-null reaction coefficient from jump intensities
